title: Unbothered by Men, Undone Before God
caption:
A man secure in Christ doesn't need the room to agree with him. He also doesn't need to be right more than he needs to be honest.

That's the tension most guys never learn to hold: thick skin toward what other men think of him, and still willing to get low in front of God about what he actually did wrong. Solomon said let another man praise you, not your own mouth. That's easy to quote and hard to live when you're the one who did the work.

Who are you more afraid of disappointing this week: the guys watching, or God?

#faith #humility #christianmen #manofgod #proverbs
